ud2.4:2.2: “Today, sir, the Blessed One is honored, respected, revered, venerated, and esteemed, receiving robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
ud2.4:2.3: The mendicant Saṅgha too is honored, respected, revered, venerated, and esteemed, receiving robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
ud2.4:2.4: But the wanderers who follow other religions are not honored, respected, revered, venerated, and esteemed, and do not receive robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
ud2.4:2.5: Then, sir, those wanderers who follow other religions, unable to bear the esteem of the Blessed One and of the mendicant Saṅgha, seeing mendicants in the village and in the forest, abuse, attack, harass, and trouble them”.
